about: The introitus of the formulary “19th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: I am the salvation of the people, says the Lord: from whatever tribulation they cry to Me, I will hear them, and I will be their Lord forever. Give heed, O My people, to My law; incline your ear to the words of My mouth. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. I am the salvation of the people, says the Lord: from whatever tribulation they cry to Me, I will hear them, and I will be their Lord forever.
